purpose: Preview layer: sub-bucket (within-5-point-bucket) continuous rating estimator per block. NOT consumed by the engine or app.

method.frame: calib/TGS archive; hitters pivot1 (split3 careers vs vR ratings) / pivot2 for steals; pitchers SP (split1, gs>=250) and RP (split1 gs==0 rows, g>=100) frames, identical to calibrate.py
method.inversion: career-pooled actual rate inverted through the archive-fitted monotone bucket curve -> implied continuous rating; delta = implied - displayed
method.noise: binomial SE of the career rate propagated through the local inverse slope; within-bucket true spread = total minus noise (quadrature)
method.delta_model: WLS (weight = career denominator), delta ~ displayed + OVR + other components, HC1 CIs. OVR coefficient is partial by construction (components included).
method.validation: out-of-frame on banked live 2044 season, split3 (vsR) actuals vs snapshot _R ratings, MLB level; intercept-recalibrated archive curve as baseline; paired bootstrap CI on weighted RMSE delta; calibration slope = live residual regressed on predicted rate shift

headline.within_bucket_true_spread: a displayed '50' in the main rate blocks truly spans ~ +-1.5 to +-2.3 rating points (1 SD); steal blocks ~ +-6 (caution flag)
headline.delta_predictor: OVR carries significant within-bucket signal for hit EYE/POW/BABIP and SP STU / SP HRR / RP CON / RP HRR (+0.05 to +0.15 implied pts per OVR pt); GAP and hitter K's do not
headline.transport_to_live: pooled calibration slope of live residuals on predicted shifts = 0.60 +- 0.21 (z=2.8) across rate blocks; SP STU->K validates individually (RMSE -2.6%, CI [-4.1%, -1.0%], calib 2.2 +- 0.5); all other single blocks are underpowered at one season (predicted shifts ~0.001-0.002 in rate vs single-season binomial floors)
headline.pot_age: POT and age are constant in the lab (POT==OVR, all age 27) - coefficients unfittable in-frame. Exploratory live-frame test (s5) finds no reliable POT-gap or age residual signal at one season (2/20 tests at ~2 sigma, chance level). Blocked on sample.

curve_knots.form: PA/BF-weighted bucket means, PAVA-monotone, piecewise linear; fitted on archive pool

within_bucket_spread.decomposition: sd_true = sqrt(max(0, sd_total^2 - mean binomial noise))

delta_model.application: delta_hat = sum_k beta_k * (x_k - mean_live_population(x_k)); center at the live population means of the target pool; terms with null live key other than 'displayed' contribute 0; add delta_hat to the displayed rating before curve evaluation
